_comment: Hyperscaler Hub, module 3: quarterly flow values the build flags as outliers (more than 5x the median of the four quarters before, above US$1bn) that were read in the filing and either confirmed (result: confirmed; the needs-review flag is cleared and the cell shows 'matched' with the quote) or explained without clearing the flag (result: reclassified). The build applies a record only when its valueUSDm matches the derived value within 0.5%. Quotes are checked against the harvested page of the cited filing (tools/hyperscalers/raw/notes). reviewedBy is a person's sign-off, null until someone signs.

items.note_en: Derivation artifact, flag kept: the six-month figure of US$1,308m (10-Q to 30 Nov 2025, 'Proceeds from issuances of common stock') includes employee stock-program proceeds, but the FY2027 first-quarter 10-Q restated the prior-year quarter to 0 under this tag (it now reports employee programs on a separate line, US$1,153m). Subtracting the restated 0 assigns the whole six months to Q2; on the original basis the quarter would be about US$138m (1,308 less 1,170 reported in the original Q1 10-Q). The year still sums (FY2026 US$1,449m), so the identity check passes while the quarter is misallocated.
items.note_es: Artefacto de derivación, aviso conservado: la cifra semestral de US$1,308 M (10-Q al 30 de noviembre de 2025, «Proceeds from issuances of common stock») incluye los recursos de los planes de acciones para empleados, pero el 10-Q del primer trimestre del año fiscal 2027 reexpresó el trimestre comparable a 0 bajo esta etiqueta (ahora reporta los planes para empleados en otra línea, US$1,153 M). Restar ese 0 reexpresado asigna todo el semestre al 2T; sobre la base original el trimestre sería de unos US$138 M (1,308 menos 1,170 reportados en el 10-Q original del 1T). El año sigue cuadrando (año fiscal 2026: US$1,449 M), así que el control de identidad pasa aunque el trimestre esté mal asignado.
